page.overview:
Who is Farnah Sadaou?

Farnah Sadaou is an Aes Sedai of the Green Ajah who became a Sitter in the Hall of the Tower after the White Tower Schism was mended. She replaced Talene Minly., Farnah Sadaou}}

In communications between Encyclopedia Wheel of Time and Brandon Sanderson, Farnah's last name is revealed to be Sadaou. Her last name is not given in The Wheel of Time Companion.

Because she is chosen as a Sitter after reunification, it can be assumed that Farnah has been Aes Sedai for more than one hundred years and is, at least around 130 years old.

Nothing is known about Farnah's strength or ability in the One Power.
